source_refs.note: Roman Urdu: practice long questions written from Chapter 21 (PDF 169-186), not printed in the book; same questions and order as the English set. Drafts needing academic review.

blocks.text: Yeh chapter 21 (Space and Environment) ke poore chapter se practice long questions (tafseeli sawal) hain, Board ke long question ki shakal mein: har 5 number ke theory sawal (definition, wazahat, derivation) ke baad usi mauzu ka 3 number ka numerical hai. Har sawal ka model jawab hai; numericals qadam ba qadam hal kiye gaye hain.

blocks.prompt:
1 What is meant by the luminosity of a star? Explain how it depends on the radius and surface temperature of the star, and obtain the Stefan-Boltzmann law for a star. (5 marks)
(Star ki luminosity se kya muraad hai? Wazahat karein ke yeh star ke radius aur surface temperature par kaise munhasir hai, aur star ke liye Stefan-Boltzmann law hasil karein.)
blocks.explanation:
Luminosity: star se fi unit waqt electromagnetic radiations ki shakal mein kharij hone wali kul energy. Yeh star ki intrinsic (asal) chamak bayan karti hai. Alamat L; unit watt (W). Suraj ki luminosity taqreeban 4 × 10²⁶ W hai.

Inhisar:
• Radius: bare star ke paas radiation kharij karne ke liye zyada surface area hai, is liye woh zyada luminous hota hai.
• Surface temperature: barabar size ke stars mein zyada garam star zyada energy kharij karta hai aur zyada luminous hai.

Stefan-Boltzmann law: luminosity = surface area × radiant intensity.
Radius r wale star ka surface area: A = 4πr²
Temperature T par radiant intensity (fi unit area power): I = σT⁴
Is liye L = A × I = 4πr²σT⁴ ... (21.1)

Bayan: star ki kul output power us ke surface area aur temperature ki chauthi power ke hasil-e-zarb ke mutanasib hai.
σ Stefan-Boltzmann constant = 5.67 × 10⁻⁸ W m⁻² K⁻⁴, T surface temperature aur r star ka radius hai.

Istemal: T maloom ho to astronomers star ka size aur chamak andaza kar sakte hain; maslan T dugna karne se L 2⁴ = 16 guna hoti hai.

book_ref.quote: Luminosity is the total amount of energy emitted by a star per unit time in the form of electromagnetic radiations

blocks.prompt:
2 A star has a luminosity of 1.2 × 10²⁷ W and a surface temperature of 10000 K. Find its radius (σ = 5.67 × 10⁻⁸ W m⁻² K⁻⁴). (3 marks)
(Aik star ki luminosity 1.2 × 10²⁷ W aur surface temperature 10000 K hai. Us ka radius nikalein.)
blocks.explanation: L = 4πr²σT⁴ ko r ke liye hal karein, phir qeematein dalein.

book_ref.quote: The luminosity of a star is given as 2.5 × 10²⁶ W

steps: Diya gaya: L = 1.2 × 10²⁷ W, T = 1.0 × 10⁴ K, σ = 5.67 × 10⁻⁸ W m⁻² K⁻⁴

blocks.prompt:
3 Define radiant flux intensity. Derive its relation with the luminosity of a star and explain the inverse-square law for it. (5 marks)
(Radiant flux intensity ki definition likhein. Star ki luminosity se is ka taluq hasil karein aur is ke liye inverse-square law samjhayein.)
blocks.explanation:
Radiant flux intensity: star se Earth ki surface tak fi unit area fi unit waqt pohanchne wali electromagnetic energy. Yeh luminosity ka chhota sa hissa hai: naapne ki jagah par fi unit area luminosity. Unit: W m⁻².

Taluq: L luminosity wala star apni energy har simt mein barabar bhejta hai. Star se r faasle par yeh energy r radius ke farzi sphere par phailti hai jis ka area 4πr² hai. Is liye
F = L/4πr² ... (21.2)
Yahan r star se naapne ki jagah tak faasla hai (star ka radius nahi).

Inverse-square law: star ki luminosity constant rehti hai, is liye F ∝ 1/r² (Fig. 21.1).
• Faasla dugna (r → 2r): F pehli qeemat ka 1/4.
• Faasla teen guna (r → 3r): F pehli qeemat ka 1/9, waghaira.

Ahmiyat: agar Earth Suraj se dugne faasle par hoti to dhoop sirf aik chauthai hoti. Agar do stars barabar flux dein to n guna door wala n² guna zyada luminous hai.

book_ref.quote: Radiant flux intensity is the amount of electromagnetic energy per unit area per unit time emitted from a star

blocks.title: Wazahat
blocks.text: Book correction: kitaab 4πr² ko 'star ka surface area' kehti hai. Asal mein F = L/4πr² mein r star se naapne ki jagah tak faasla hai, aur 4πr² us farzi sphere ka area hai jis par luminosity phailti hai.

blocks.prompt:
4 A star of luminosity 3.0 × 10²⁶ W is 2.0 × 10¹¹ m from a planet. Find the radiant flux intensity at the planet. What would it be if the planet were twice as far? (3 marks)
(3.0 × 10²⁶ W luminosity wala star aik planet se 2.0 × 10¹¹ m door hai. Planet par radiant flux intensity nikalein. Agar planet dugne faasle par ho to kitni hogi?)
blocks.explanation: F = L/4πr² lagayein, phir dugne faasle ke liye inverse-square law.

book_ref.quote: The luminosity of a star is 4.50 ×10²⁶ W

steps: Diya gaya: L = 3.0 × 10²⁶ W, r = 2.0 × 10¹¹ m
blocks.final_answer: F = 6.0 × 10² W m⁻²; dugne faasle par F = 1.5 × 10² W m⁻²

blocks.prompt:
5 What are standard candles? Describe how the distance of a standard candle is found, and give two examples with the property that makes them suitable. (5 marks)
(Standard candles kya hain? Bayan karein ke standard candle ka faasla kaise nikala jata hai, aur do misalein woh khasiyat bata kar dein jo unhein munasib banati hai.)
blocks.explanation:
Standard candles: aise falaki ajsaam jin ki intrinsic (asal) chamak yani luminosity maloom ho; in se kaainati faasle naape jate hain. Stars aur galaxies ke faasle naapna kaainat ki banawat aur phailao samajhne ke liye zaroori hai.

Tareeqa:
1. Standard candle ki luminosity L (asal chamak) maloom hoti hai.
2. Earth se woh kitna chamakdar nazar aata hai (apparent magnitude), yani Earth tak pohanchne wali radiant flux F naapi jati hai.
3. Light ke inverse-square law se F = L/4πd², is liye faasla
d = √(L/4πF)

Misalein:
• Cepheid variable stars: yeh maloom tareeqe se pulse karte hain (1910s mein Henrietta Swan Leavitt ki daryaft).
• Type Ia supernovae.
Dono ki luminosity pehle se maloom (predictable) hoti hai, is liye yeh faasle ke qabil-e-aitbaar nishan hain.

book_ref.quote: The standard candles are astronomical objects with known intrinsic brightness

blocks.prompt:
6 A Type Ia supernova used as a standard candle has a luminosity of 5.0 × 10³⁵ W. The flux received at the Earth is 1.0 × 10⁻¹¹ W m⁻². Find its distance from the Earth. (3 marks)
(Standard candle ke tor par istemal hone wale Type Ia supernova ki luminosity 5.0 × 10³⁵ W hai. Earth par milne wali flux 1.0 × 10⁻¹¹ W m⁻² hai. Earth se us ka faasla nikalein.)
blocks.explanation: Maloom luminosity aur naapi gayi flux se d = √(L/4πF) faasla deta hai.

book_ref.quote: astronomers can calculate its distance using the inverse-square law of light

steps: Diya gaya: L = 5.0 × 10³⁵ W, F = 1.0 × 10⁻¹¹ W m⁻²

blocks.prompt:
7 What is a blackbody? Describe a practical blackbody and explain the main features of blackbody radiation spectra at different temperatures. Why are stars treated as blackbodies? (5 marks)
(Blackbody kya hai? Amli blackbody bayan karein aur mukhtalif temperatures par blackbody radiation spectra ki ahem khasiyat samjhayein. Stars ko blackbody kyun samjha jata hai?)
blocks.explanation:
Garam ajsaam: garam jism chamakta hai aur radiation deta hai jo sirf us ke temperature par munhasir hai, material ya shakal par nahi. Temperature barhne se rang halka surkh → chamakdar peela → safaid hota hai. Haqeeqi ajsaam tamam radiation poori jazb ya kharij nahi karte, is liye aik ideal jism, blackbody, ka tasawwur liya jata hai.

Blackbody: aisa jism jo apne upar girne wali tamam radiation jazb kare aur har wavelength par mukammal radiation kharij kare.

Amli blackbody (Fig. 21.3): chhote surakh aur kaali andaruni deewaron (carbon soot) wala khokhla cavity. Surakh se dakhil radiation andar takra takra kar phans jati hai aur jazb ho jati hai. Cavity ko kaafi garam karne par woh tamam wavelengths ki radiation kharij karti hai: blackbody radiation.

Spectra ki khasiyat (intensity aur wavelength, Fig. 21.4):
1. Pattern sirf blackbody ke temperature par munhasir hai.
2. Temperature barhne se kharij energy barhti hai (curve ooncha hota hai).
3. Temperature barhne se peak chhoti wavelengths ki taraf khisakti hai; zyada garam blackbody chhoti wavelengths par zyada energy deta hai (Wien's law, λmax T = 2.9 × 10⁻³ m K).

Stars bataur blackbody: Suraj jaise stars nuclear fusion se energy banate aur bohat si wavelengths par baghair khala ke continuous spectrum ki shakal mein kharij karte hain jo blackbody spectrum jaisa hai. Is se un ka surface temperature andaza hota hai.

book_ref.quote: A blackbody is one that absorbs all the radiations falling on it and also emits radiations at all wavelengths perfectly

blocks.prompt:
8 A blackbody cavity is heated to 3000 K. Find (i) the wavelength at which it emits most intensely and (ii) the power it emits per unit area, I = σT⁴ (b = 2.9 × 10⁻³ m K, σ = 5.67 × 10⁻⁸ W m⁻² K⁻⁴). (3 marks)
(Aik blackbody cavity 3000 K tak garam ki jati hai. (i) sab se zyada intensity wali wavelength aur (ii) fi unit area kharij power I = σT⁴ nikalein.)
blocks.explanation: Wien's law se λmax; radiant intensity σT⁴ hai.

book_ref.quote: As the temperature increases, the energy it gives off also increases

blocks.prompt:
9 State Wien's displacement law and write it in mathematical form. Explain how it accounts for the colours of heated objects and stars, and how it is used to find the temperature of a star. (5 marks)
(Wien's displacement law bayan karein aur riyazi shakal mein likhein. Wazahat karein ke yeh garam ajsaam aur stars ke rangon ko kaise samjhata hai aur star ka temperature nikalne mein kaise istemal hota hai.)
blocks.explanation:
Wien's displacement law blackbody ke surface temperature T aur us wavelength λmax ka taluq bayan karta hai jis par woh sab se zyada shiddat se radiation deta hai.

Bayan: blackbody ki maximum intensity wali radiation ki wavelength us ke surface temperature ke ulat mutanasib hai.
λmax ∝ 1/T
yani λmax T = b ... (21.3)
jahan b Wien ka constant = 2.9 × 10⁻³ m K hai.

Matlab: temperature barhne se λmax chhoti qeematon ki taraf khisakti hai.
• Zyada garam ajsaam chhoti wavelengths (neeli ya banafshi) dete hain.
• Thande ajsaam lambi wavelengths (surkh ya infrared) dete hain.
Yahi khisakna garam ajsaam ke rang ki tabdeeli samjhata hai (halka surkh → peela → safaid).

Star ka temperature: star ke spectrum se λmax parh kar T = b/λmax. Do stars ke liye λmax1 T₁ = λmax2 T₂, is liye T₂ = λmax1 T₁/λmax2. Chhoti peak wavelength ka matlab zyada garam star.

book_ref.quote: The wavelength corresponding to the radiation of maximum intensity emitted by a blackbody is inversely proportional to its surface temperature

blocks.prompt:
10 Star A has a surface temperature of 5000 K and a peak wavelength of 600 nm. Star B has a peak wavelength of 400 nm. Find the surface temperature of star B. If both stars have the same radius, how many times more luminous is B? (3 marks)
(Star A ka surface temperature 5000 K aur peak wavelength 600 nm hai. Star B ki peak wavelength 400 nm hai. Star B ka surface temperature nikalein. Agar dono ka radius barabar ho to B kitne guna zyada luminous hai?)
blocks.explanation: Dono stars ke liye λmax T barabar hai; barabar radius par L ∝ T⁴.

book_ref.quote: Another star has a peak wavelength of 320 nm

steps: Diya gaya: T_A = 5000 K, λ_A = 600 nm, λ_B = 400 nm
blocks.final_answer: T_B = 7500 K; B taqreeban 5.1 guna zyada luminous hai

blocks.prompt:
11 Explain how the radius of a star is determined by using Wien's displacement law, the radiant flux intensity and the Stefan-Boltzmann law. Obtain the formula used. (5 marks)
(Wazahat karein ke Wien's displacement law, radiant flux intensity aur Stefan-Boltzmann law se star ka radius kaise maloom kiya jata hai. Istemal hone wala formula hasil karein.)
blocks.explanation:
Star ka radius Wien's displacement law aur Stefan-Boltzmann law se teen qadmon mein nikala jata hai.

Qadam 1 (surface temperature): star ke spectrum se maximum intensity ki wavelength λmax parhi jati hai. Wien ke qanoon λmax T = b se
T = b/λmax  (b = 2.9 × 10⁻³ m K)

Qadam 2 (luminosity): Earth par star ki radiant flux intensity F naapi jati hai. Star ka faasla d ho to F = L/4πd² se
L = 4πd²F

Qadam 3 (radius): Stefan-Boltzmann law L = 4πr²σT⁴ se
r² = L/(4πσT⁴)
r = √(L/4πσT⁴)  (σ = 5.67 × 10⁻⁸ W m⁻² K⁻⁴)

Mila kar: r = √[4πd²F/(4πσ(b/λmax)⁴)] = (d λmax²/b²)√(F/σ).

book_ref.quote: The radius of a star can be calculated using Wien's displacement law and the Stefan-Boltzmann law

blocks.prompt:
12 The peak wavelength of a star's radiation is 580 nm. At a planet 1.2 × 10¹¹ m from the star, the radiant flux intensity is 1.0 × 10³ W m⁻². Find the radius of the star (b = 2.9 × 10⁻³ m K, σ = 5.67 × 10⁻⁸ W m⁻² K⁻⁴). (3 marks)
(Aik star ki radiation ki peak wavelength 580 nm hai. Star se 1.2 × 10¹¹ m door planet par radiant flux intensity 1.0 × 10³ W m⁻² hai. Star ka radius nikalein.)
blocks.explanation: Wien's law se T, flux aur faasle se L, aur Stefan-Boltzmann law se r.

book_ref.quote: The Luminosity of a star can be calculated using the radiant flux intensity

blocks.prompt:
13 Explain how the absorption spectrum of a star is formed. Why are the dark lines not filled in by re-emitted light? What change is seen in the spectral lines of distant stars and galaxies? (5 marks)
(Star ka absorption spectrum kaise banta hai, wazahat karein. Kaali lines dobara kharij light se kyun nahi bhartin? Door stars aur galaxies ki spectral lines mein kya tabdeeli nazar aati hai?)
blocks.explanation:
Continuous spectrum: stars ki intehai garam, ghani surfaces taqreeban mukammal blackbody ki tarah hain, is liye woh continuous spectrum dete hain.

Absorption: yeh light star ke thande bairooni atmosphere se guzarti hai to gas ki tahon ke atoms energy levels ke darmiyan electronic transitions ke mutabiq khaas wavelengths jazb kar lete hain. Is se continuous spectrum mein kaali lines banti hain: yeh absorption spectrum hai.

Lines kaali kyun rehti hain: jazb shuda energy usi wavelength par dobara kharij hoti hai magar photons mukhtalif simton mein bikhar jate hain, is liye Earth tak kam pohanchte hain. Is liye hamein ghayab wavelengths wala absorption spectrum milta hai.

Door stars aur galaxies (Fig. 21.5): un ke spectra mein lines ki wavelength laboratory qeemat se barh jati hai. Ise redshift kehte hain; yeh kaainat mein safar karte photons ke khinchne se hota hai. (Kami, yani manfi Δλ, blue shift hogi: source qareeb aa raha hai.)

book_ref.quote: Stars emit a continuous spectrum of light because of their extremely hot, dense surfaces

blocks.prompt:
14 A spectral line with laboratory wavelength 656 nm is observed at 652.72 nm in the light of a star. Find Δλ and Z, state whether this is a redshift or a blue shift, and find the speed of the star (c = 3 × 10⁸ m s⁻¹). (3 marks)
(656 nm laboratory wavelength wali spectral line aik star ki light mein 652.72 nm par nazar aati hai. Δλ aur Z nikalein, batayein ke redshift hai ya blue shift, aur star ki speed nikalein.)
blocks.explanation: Δλ = naapi gayi − laboratory; is ka nishan simt batata hai aur |Z|c speed deta hai.

book_ref.quote: a negative Δλ, represents a blue shift, showing that the object is approaching the Earth

steps: Manfi Δλ → blue shift: star Earth ki taraf aa raha hai
blocks.final_answer: Blue shift, Z = −0.0050; star 1.5 × 10⁶ m s⁻¹ se qareeb aa raha hai

blocks.prompt:
15 What is cosmic redshift? Write the redshift relation and explain how redshift shows that the universe is expanding and supports the Big Bang theory. (5 marks)
(Cosmic redshift kya hai? Redshift ka taluq likhein aur wazahat karein ke redshift kaise kaainat ka phailao dikhata aur Big Bang theory ki taeed karta hai.)
blocks.explanation:
Cosmic redshift: door galaxies ki light ka spectrum ke surkh sire ki taraf khinch jana. Kaainat phail rahi hai aur galaxies hum se door ja rahi hain, is liye un ki light ki wavelength barh jati hai.

Taluq: wavelength ki tabdeeli source aur observer ki relative velocity se seedha juri hai:
Z = Δλ/λ ≈ Δf/f ≈ v/c ... (21.4)  (jab speed c se bohat kam ho)
• Δλ musbat → redshift: jism Earth se door ja raha hai.
• Δλ manfi → blue shift: jism Earth ki taraf aa raha hai.

Phailao ki daleel:
1. Galaxy jitni door, us ka redshift utna zyada, yani woh utni tezi se door ja rahi hai.
2. Kaainat ke phailne se space khud khinch rahi hai; is se light ki lehrein khinch kar lambi ho jati hain.
3. Redshift har simt mein nazar aata hai jo kaainat ke phailao ki nishani hai. Galaxies sirf space mein door nahi ja rahin; un ke darmiyan space barh rahi hai.

Big Bang: yeh nataij Big Bang theory ki mazboot taeed karte hain jo kehti hai ke kaainat intehai garam aur ghani halat se shuru hui aur tab se barh rahi hai. Redshift aur faasle ke taluq se kaainat ka size aur waqt ke saath tabdeeli maloom hoti hai.

book_ref.quote: Cosmic redshift refers to the effect in which light coming from distant galaxies across the universe is stretched toward the red end of the spectrum

blocks.title: Wazahat
blocks.text: Book correction: kitaab mein Eq. (21.4) '>>' (bohat zyada) aur λ ki jagah ℓ ke saath chhapi hai. Durust: teeno ratios taqreeban barabar hain, Z = Δλ/λ ≈ Δf/f ≈ v/c.

blocks.prompt:
16 A hydrogen line of laboratory wavelength 486 nm is observed at 510 nm in the spectrum of a galaxy. Find the redshift Z and the speed at which the galaxy is receding (c = 3 × 10⁸ m s⁻¹). (3 marks)
(486 nm laboratory wavelength wali hydrogen line aik galaxy ke spectrum mein 510 nm par nazar aati hai. Redshift Z aur galaxy ki door jane ki speed nikalein.)
blocks.explanation: Δλ nikalein, λ se taqseem kar ke Z, phir v = Zc.

book_ref.quote: By studying cosmic redshift, scientists can measure how fast the universe is expanding

steps: v = 1.5 × 10⁷ m s⁻¹ (door ja rahi hai)

blocks.prompt:
17 State Hubble's law and write it in equation form. Explain the graph of Hubble's law and the inflated-balloon model, and show how the law leads to the Big Bang theory. (5 marks)
(Hubble's law bayan karein aur equation ki shakal mein likhein. Hubble's law ka graph aur inflated-balloon model samjhayein, aur dikhayein ke yeh qanoon Big Bang theory tak kaise le jata hai.)
blocks.explanation:
Edwin Hubble ne dikhaya ke galaxies Earth se door ja rahi hain aur un ki velocity faasle ke saath barhti hai: galaxy jitni door, utni tez door jati hai.

Hubble's law: galaxy ki recession velocity v Earth se us ke faasle d ke seedha mutanasib hai.
v ∝ d
v = H₀d ... (21.5)
H₀ Hubble ka constant = 2.3 × 10⁻¹⁸ s⁻¹ hai.

Graph (Fig. 21.6): recession velocity aur faasle ka graph seedhi line hai, jo phailti kaainat ki mazboot daleel hai. Is ki slope Hubble constant H₀ hai jo phailao ki raftaar batata hai.

Balloon model (Fig. 21.7): balloon par nuqte galaxies aur jild space-time hai. Balloon phulane par har nuqta baqi nuqton ko door jata 'dekhta' hai. Is liye (1) kaainat mein kahin se bhi galaxies door jati nazar aati hain: phailao har jagah hai, koi khaas markaz nahi, Earth markaz mein nahi; (2) space khud khinch rahi hai.

Big Bang: waqt ulta chalayen to maazi mein galaxies qareeb thin; aur peeche tamam maadda bohat chhoti, ghani aur garam halat mein tha. Big Bang theory ke mutabiq kaainat taqreeban 13.8 billion saal pehle aik ibtidai singularity se shuru hui aur tab se phail rahi hai. Hubble's law dikhata hai ke kaainat saakin nahi balke phail rahi hai.

book_ref.quote: The recession velocity v of a galaxy is directly proportional to its distance d from the Earth

blocks.prompt:
18 A line of laboratory wavelength 600 nm appears at 606 nm in the spectrum of a galaxy. Find the recession speed of the galaxy and its distance from the Earth (c = 3 × 10⁸ m s⁻¹, H₀ = 2.3 × 10⁻¹⁸ s⁻¹). (3 marks)
(600 nm laboratory wavelength wali line aik galaxy ke spectrum mein 606 nm par nazar aati hai. Galaxy ki recession speed aur Earth se faasla nikalein.)
blocks.explanation: Redshift se speed (v = Zc); Hubble's law se faasla (d = v/H₀).

book_ref.quote: Hₒ is called Hubble's constant and its value is 2.3×10⁻¹⁸ s⁻¹

blocks.prompt:
19 What is Earth's energy budget? Explain the roles of ice and dark surfaces and of greenhouse gases in it, and describe how the energy imbalance between the poles and the equator drives atmospheric circulation. (5 marks)
(Earth ka energy budget kya hai? Is mein barf, gehri surfaces aur greenhouse gases ka kirdar samjhayein, aur bayan karein ke poles aur equator ke darmiyan energy ka adm-e-tawazun atmospheric circulation kaise chalata hai.)
blocks.explanation:
Energy budget: Earth ki jazb shuda solar energy aur space mein wapas kharij energy ka tawazun. Yeh batata hai ke kitni solar energy milti aur kitni reflection aur emission se zaya hoti hai. Earth Suraj ki energy ka sirf taqreeban 70% jazb karti hai; baqi badal, barf aur sehra reflect karte hain.

Barf aur gehri surfaces:
• Earth thandi ho to zyada barf surface dhaanp leti hai. Chamakdar hone ki wajah se yeh bohat si dhoop space mein reflect karti hai aur Earth aur thandi hoti hai.
• Earth garam ho to barf pighalti hai aur gehri zameen aur samandar khul jate hain jo zyada dhoop jazb aur kam reflect karte hain, is liye Earth aur garam hoti hai.

Tawazun aur greenhouse gases (Fig. 21.12): Suraj se aane wali energy infrared (heat) radiation ki shakal mein jane wali energy se mutawazin hoti hai; tawazun ho to temperature constant rehta hai. Greenhouse gases infrared radiation phansa leti hain, is liye Earth garam hoti hai: global warming. Sirf 1% adm-e-tawazun bhi bari tabdeeli la sakta hai.

Poles-equator adm-e-tawazun (Fig. 21.13): equator par seedhi tez dhoop; garam hawa uth kar low-pressure zones banati hai. Poles par tirchhi kamzor dhoop; thandi hawa baith kar high-pressure zones banati hai. Yeh adm-e-tawazun global atmospheric circulation chalata hai: equator ke qareeb trade winds, darmiyani latitudes mein westerlies, poles ke qareeb polar easterlies. Yeh hawaein ocean currents ke saath heat duniya bhar mein phailati hain.

book_ref.quote: The Earth's energy budget refers to the balance between the solar energy absorbed by the Earth and the energy it radiates back into space

blocks.prompt:
20 The Sun has a luminosity of about 4 × 10²⁶ W and the Earth is 1.5 × 10¹¹ m from it. Find the radiant flux intensity of sunlight at the Earth, and the part of it absorbed if the Earth absorbs about 70% of the Sun's energy. (3 marks)
(Suraj ki luminosity taqreeban 4 × 10²⁶ W hai aur Earth us se 1.5 × 10¹¹ m door hai. Earth par dhoop ki radiant flux intensity nikalein, aur agar Earth Suraj ki energy ka taqreeban 70% jazb kare to jazb hissa nikalein.)
blocks.explanation: F = L/4πr² se flux; is ka 70% jazb hota hai.

book_ref.quote: The Earth only absorbs about 70% of the Sun's energy

steps: Diya gaya: L = 4 × 10²⁶ W, r = 1.5 × 10¹¹ m
blocks.final_answer: F = 1.4 × 10³ W m⁻²; jazb taqreeban 9.9 × 10² W m⁻²

blocks.prompt:
21 Explain the role of conservation of angular momentum in atmospheric circulation. Define specific angular momentum, describe the Coriolis effect and name the atmospheric cells it produces. (5 marks)
(Atmospheric circulation mein angular momentum ki conservation ka kirdar samjhayein. Specific angular momentum ki definition likhein, Coriolis effect bayan karein aur is se banne wale atmospheric cells ke naam batayein.)
blocks.explanation:
Atmospheric circulation par angular momentum ki conservation aur Earth ki gardish ka gehra asar hai.

Earth ke rotation axis ke gird hawa ke mass ka angular momentum: L = mvr, jahan m hawa ka mass, r axis se faasla aur v velocity hai.

Specific angular momentum: fi unit mass angular momentum,
L = rv ... (21.6)

Conservation: hawa equator aur poles ke darmiyan harkat karte hue apna specific angular momentum qaim rakhti hai, yani rv constant. Pole ki taraf jate hue r kam hota hai, is liye v barhti hai.

Coriolis effect: Earth ki surface equator par oonche latitudes se tez ghoomti hai. Equator se pole ki taraf jati hawa (barhi hui v) neeche ki ahista ghoomti zameen se aage nikal jati hai, aur pole se equator ki taraf aati hawa tez ghoomti surface se peeche reh jati hai. Earth ki gardish se harkat karti hawa ka yeh zahiri murna Coriolis effect hai. Northern hemisphere mein daayen aur southern mein baayen murna hota hai. Yeh speed nahi badalta, sirf raasta, aur khamdar hawa ke patterns banata hai.

Cells: yeh mure hue bahao har hemisphere mein teen cells banate hain: Hadley cell, Ferrel cell aur Polar cell (Fig. 21.14).

book_ref.quote: The angular momentum of an air mass about Earth's rotation axis is given by L = mvr

blocks.title: Wazahat
blocks.text: Book correction: kitaab kehti hai equator se pole ki taraf jati hawa zameen se 'peeche reh jati hai'. Asal mein rv constant hone se is ki speed barhti hai aur yeh aage nikalti hai; pole se equator ki taraf aane wali hawa peeche reh jati hai.

blocks.prompt:
22 An air mass moving from a polar region towards the equator is 3.2 × 10⁶ m from the Earth's rotation axis, with speed 600 m s⁻¹ about the axis. Keeping its specific angular momentum constant, it reaches 4.8 × 10⁶ m from the axis. Find (i) its specific angular momentum and (ii) its new speed. (3 marks)
(Polar ilaqe se equator ki taraf jata hawa ka mass Earth ke rotation axis se 3.2 × 10⁶ m par hai aur axis ke gird speed 600 m s⁻¹ hai. Specific angular momentum constant rakhte hue yeh axis se 4.8 × 10⁶ m par pohanchta hai. (i) specific angular momentum aur (ii) nayi speed nikalein.)
blocks.explanation: Specific angular momentum L = rv constant rehta hai, is liye v₂ = r₁v₁/r₂.

book_ref.quote: As the air mass moves, r decreases and so v increases to keep rv constant

steps: Diya gaya: r₁ = 3.2 × 10⁶ m, v₁ = 600 m s⁻¹, r₂ = 4.8 × 10⁶ m
v₂ = 400 m s⁻¹ (r barha, is liye v kam hui)
blocks.final_answer: L = 1.92 × 10⁹ m² s⁻¹; v₂ = 400 m s⁻¹

blocks.prompt:
23 Explain the role of salt and temperature in the density of seawater. Describe thermohaline circulation (the global conveyor belt) and its importance for the Earth's climate. (5 marks)
(Samandari paani ki density mein namak aur temperature ka kirdar samjhayein. Thermohaline circulation (global conveyor belt) bayan karein aur Earth ke climate ke liye is ki ahmiyat batayein.)
blocks.explanation:
Salinity aur density (21.13): samandari paani mein namak ki miqdaar salinity hai. Hal shuda namak paani ka mass barhata hai magar volume khaas nahi barhata, is liye zyada salinity yani zyada density. Thanda paani garam se aur namkeen paani kam namkeen se zyada ghana hai.

Doobna: jab surface ka paani (evaporation ya samandari barf banne se) thanda aur namkeen ho jaye to ghana ho kar doob jata hai. Doobta paani doosre paani ko hatata hai aur duniya bhar mein ahista magar bari currents banti hain. Yeh gehri gardish heat aur gases (oxygen, carbon dioxide) le jati aur surface aur gehre paani ko jorti hai.

Thermohaline circulation (global conveyor belt, Fig. 21.15): paani ke temperature aur salinity ke farq se chalti hai jo mil kar density tay karte hain.
1. Equator ke qareeb garam, kam ghana paani surface par poles ki taraf heat le kar jata hai (surkh ribbons).
2. Polar ilaqon mein paani thanda hota hai aur barf banne se salinity barhti hai; ghana ho kar doobta hai (neele ribbons).
3. Thanda ghana paani samandar ki tah par equator ki taraf wapas jata hai aur baad mein doosre ilaqon mein oopar uthta hai.
Tamam samandari basins mein aik poora chakkar taqreeban 1,000 saal leta hai.

Ahmiyat: yeh tropics se poles tak heat le jati hai, Earth ka climate mutawazin rakhti hai, atmosphere ke patterns par asar dalti hai aur heat aur nutrients phaila kar samandari ecosystems ko sahara deti hai. Agar global warming ise ahista kar de to Europe ko chhota ice age pesh aa sakta hai.

book_ref.quote: Thermohaline circulation, often referred to as the global conveyor belt

blocks.prompt:
24 1.000 m³ of fresh water has a mass of 1000 kg. When 35 kg of salt is dissolved in it, the volume increases negligibly. Using density = mass/volume, find the density of the salty water and the percentage increase in density. (3 marks)
(1.000 m³ meethe paani ka mass 1000 kg hai. Is mein 35 kg namak hal karne se volume na hone ke barabar barhta hai. Density = mass/volume se namkeen paani ki density aur density mein feesad izafa nikalein.)
blocks.explanation: Namak mass barhata hai magar volume (taqreeban) nahi, is liye density mass ke hisaab se barhti hai.

book_ref.quote: the dissolved salt increases the mass of the water without significantly increasing its volume

steps: Meetha paani: ρ₁ = 1000 kg / 1.000 m³ = 1000 kg m⁻³
Namkeen paani: mass = 1000 + 35 = 1035 kg, volume ≈ 1.000 m³
blocks.final_answer: ρ = 1035 kg m⁻³, meethe paani se taqreeban 3.5% zyada ghana
